title: Canonical derived constant-sheaf pullback comparison
statement: Let $X,Z$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], let $p:Z\to X$ be any scheme morphism and let $A$ be a commutative ring, with the common module universe of [def-weil-size-convention]. In the ordinary module-valued derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], define the natural isomorphism $\underline{(-)}_Z\cong Lp^{-1}\circ\underline{(-)}_X$ from the derived constant functor [def-kun-constant-sheaf] to its composite with derived inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. It is obtained by deriving the inverse of the canonical ordinary constant-sheaf pullback comparison and composing with the canonical exact-functor derived-composition isomorphism. This specifies the comparison on every complex and every morphism, with no boundedness or finiteness assumption.

source.place: Tags 0G7E and 08J9; canonical constant and inverse-image comparisons in the external Hom evaluation

lean.statement:
def derivedConstantPullbackIso {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (p : Z ⟶ X) :
    (constantSheaf Z.smallEtaleTopology A).leftDerivedFunctor ≅
      (constantSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology A).leftDerivedFunctor ⋙
        L((p)^*[A])
lean.note: The existing definition is generic in an abelian symmetric monoidal Grothendieck coefficient category with functorial flat resolutions; specialize its coefficient A to ModuleCat.{u+1} R. The category hypotheses are supplied by the existing instances for every commutative R. This records only the canonical definition and does not cite or use the finite-ring Kunneth theorem.
